title: FARM & TABLE
blurb: What grows in the field and what it turns into.

radicals.name: GRAIN
radicals.origin: A stalk of ripe grain with its heavy head bending over. That bent stroke on top is all that separates it from 木, a tree.
radicals.clue: crops, harvests and what was paid in grain
ex: what the next crop grows from. Read zhòng, it means to plant
grain 禾 the colour of fire 火: harvest time
rice while it is still growing
rent was once paid in grain
radicals.watch: Look-alike: 木 (tree) has a flat top. 禾 has a slanted stroke above it, the drooping head of grain. 和 (and) and 利 (profit) contain 禾 but are filed under mouth and knife.

radicals.name: RICE
radicals.origin: Grains of rice scattered around a cross, as if spilled on a table. 米 is rice after the harvest and before the pot.
radicals.clue: rice, flour and food made from grain
ex: the first sweets were boiled down from grain
radicals.watch: Chinese has a word for each stage. 稻 is rice in the field (grain radical). 米 is the raw grain. 饭 is rice cooked and served (food radical). 米 is also the word for a metre.

radicals.name: WINE JAR
radicals.origin: A clay wine jar with a narrow neck. The line inside shows how full it is.
radicals.clue: alcohol and things brewed or fermented
radicals.watch: Look-alike: 西 (west) is empty inside. 酉 has one more line across the middle: the wine in the jar. 酒 has water on its left, but dictionaries file it under the jar.

radicals.name: DISH
radicals.origin: A wide bowl on a stand, seen from the side. It always sits at the bottom and holds up the rest of the character like a tray.
ex: a container that closes: 合 means to shut
what goes on top of the dish
radicals.watch: Look-alike: 四 (four) has two curved legs inside and no base line. 皿 has two straight lines and a long base that sticks out at both ends.

radicals.name: CLOTH
radicals.origin: A piece of cloth hanging from a belt. 毛巾 is a towel and 围巾 is a scarf.
radicals.clue: a piece of cloth and things made from one
ex: a cloth belt with its tied ends hanging down
cloth hung across an opening 穴
radicals.watch: 巾 is a flat piece of cloth. Finished clothing has its own radical, 衤 (裤, 衬), and thread has 纟. 常 (often) is filed here too, with no cloth in sight.
